from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Optional

class CompanyFinancialMetric(BaseModel):
    """Extracted financial metric from one company's quarterly report."""
    company_name: Optional[str] = Field(description="The company name as written in the report")
    stock_code: Optional[str] = Field(description="The stock/security code if provided")
    profit_metric: Optional[str] = Field(description="The specific metric name in Chinese/English")
    profit_value: Optional[float] = Field(description="The numerical profit value extracted; can be negative for losses")
    currency_unit: Optional[str] = Field(description="The currency unit (e.g. '元')")
    reporting_period: Optional[str] = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g. '2024年第一季度'")
    raw_quote: str = Field(description="The verbatim line from the document containing this metric")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_financial_metrics: list[CompanyFinancialMetric]
